description: Full clean-state verification: prove the developer workflow and all 3 backend Docker images build deterministically from a completely clean checkout, exactly the Fly way. Depends on FEAT-002.
steps: Start every command with `source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22`.
Run full `pnpm build` from clean and confirm it PASSES (no TS2307, no TS7006). Capture result.

Run `pnpm test` from clean (after build) and record the passing test count (baseline ~2811). Confirm vitest still discovers and runs test files (excluding tests from the tsc BUILD config must NOT reduce vitest coverage).
Run `pnpm depcruise` and confirm it passes.

Build all 3 backend images the EXACT Fly way from clean, one at a time (podman): `podman build --build-arg BUILD_TARGET=apps/control-plane-api -t t-cpa .`, `podman build --build-arg BUILD_TARGET=apps/worker -t t-worker .`, `podman build --build-arg BUILD_TARGET=apps/agent-runtime -t t-agent .`. Each must complete successfully.

For each image, confirm the entrypoint exists inside the image: e.g. `podman run --rm t-worker ls apps/worker/dist/main.js apps/worker/dist/index.js`, and `podman run --rm t-cpa ls apps/control-plane-api/dist/main.js`, `podman run --rm t-agent ls apps/agent-runtime/dist/main.js`.

Confirm NONE of the 4 Next.js consoles were built inside the backend images (grep the build logs to confirm no `next build` ran and no .next dirs for consoles; the filter should only touch the target app + @counter deps).
Record all counts and pass/fail results in findings.
acceptance_criteria: `pnpm test` passes from clean with a recorded count at or near the ~2811 baseline (report the exact number).
All 3 podman images (t-cpa, t-worker, t-agent) build successfully from clean and contain their dist/main.js entrypoint (worker also dist/index.js).
No Next.js console (`next build`) is executed inside any backend image build.
verification: source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 && find . -name '*.tsbuildinfo' -not -path './node_modules/*' -delete && rm -rf apps/*/dist packages/*/dist && pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm depcruise

podman build --build-arg BUILD_TARGET=apps/control-plane-api -t t-cpa . && podman build --build-arg BUILD_TARGET=apps/worker -t t-worker . && podman build --build-arg BUILD_TARGET=apps/agent-runtime -t t-agent .

podman run --rm t-worker ls apps/worker/dist/main.js apps/worker/dist/index.js && podman run --rm t-cpa ls apps/control-plane-api/dist/main.js && podman run --rm t-agent ls apps/agent-runtime/dist/main.js
findings:
FULL CLEAN-STATE VERIFICATION PASSED. Env: Node v22.23.2 (nvm use 22), pnpm 9.15.4, podman 5.2.3, OPEN_INTERNET. No source changes were needed; FEAT-001/002 fix (project references + `tsc -b` + per-package tsconfig.build.json excluding **/*.test.ts & **/*.integration.test.ts + name-filter Dockerfile) verified as-is. All commands prefixed with `source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22`.

A. CLEAN: `find . -name '*.tsbuildinfo' -not -path './node_modules/*' -delete && rm -rf apps/*/dist packages/*/dist` -> 0 dist dirs, 0 tsbuildinfo remaining.
B. `pnpm build` (full root, incl Next consoles + reference apps) from clean -> EXIT 0. All 31 tsc projects report 'Done' via `tsc -b tsconfig.build.json`. ZERO TS2307, ZERO TS7006, ZERO 'error TS' in output. Zero *.test.js/*.integration.test.js emitted into any dist. Entrypoints present: apps/worker/dist/{main.js,index.js}, apps/control-plane-api/dist/main.js, apps/agent-runtime/dist/main.js.
C. `pnpm test` from clean (after build) -> EXIT 0. EXACT PASSING COUNT = 2811 passed, 0 failed (matches ~2811 baseline EXACTLY). 34 projects reported a 'Test Files' summary, confirming vitest still discovers & runs all test files; excluding tests from the tsc BUILD config did NOT reduce vitest coverage (vitest uses esbuild transform, no tsc typecheck at test time). Some integration tests skipped by design (require external infra), consistent with baseline.
D. `pnpm depcruise` -> EXIT 0. 'no dependency violations found (1848 modules, 4202 dependencies cruised)'.
E. THREE BACKEND IMAGES built the EXACT Fly way from clean (dist+tsbuildinfo deleted from host first so image compiles genuinely fresh), one at a time via podman:
   - `podman build --build-arg BUILD_TARGET=apps/control-plane-api -t t-cpa .` -> EXIT 0. Build step compiled 7 projects (domain, trust-protocol, workflow, authorization, http-api-kit, data, control-plane-api) via `tsc -b`.
   - `podman build --build-arg BUILD_TARGET=apps/worker -t t-worker .` -> EXIT 0. Compiled 12 projects (domain, config, trust-protocol, commerce-graph, connector-sdk, workflow, authorization, shopify-connector, payment-sdk, data, razorpay-adapter, worker).
   - `podman build --build-arg BUILD_TARGET=apps/agent-runtime -t t-agent .` -> EXIT 0. Compiled 9 projects (domain, trust-protocol, contracts, workflow, merchant-contracts, authorization, http-api-kit, data, agent-runtime).
   Each image build log: 0 'next build', 0 console build lines, 0 'error TS'. The `node -p` name-filter resolves the target closure to the app + its @counter deps ONLY.
F. ENTRYPOINTS confirmed INSIDE each image: `podman run --rm t-worker ls apps/worker/dist/main.js apps/worker/dist/index.js` -> both present; t-cpa apps/control-plane-api/dist/main.js -> present; t-agent apps/agent-runtime/dist/main.js -> present.
G. NO NEXT.JS CONSOLE BUILT IN ANY BACKEND IMAGE: grep of all 3 image build logs = 0 occurrences of `next build` and 0 of landing/merchant-console/operations-console/wallet-console build lines. OOM fix preserved.
   NOTE (pre-existing, out of scope, already documented in FEAT-002): repo has NO .dockerignore, so `COPY . .` copies host-side apps/*/.next dirs into the image (their host mtimes ~18:21 predate all podman builds at 18:22+, proving they were copied, not built). The image BUILD never runs `next build` (logs show only `tsc -b`), so the OOM constraint 'do not build the Next consoles in the backend image' HOLDS.

CLEANUP: removed temp podman images (t-cpa/t-worker/t-agent) and temp logs; left source tree clean of dist/tsbuildinfo. Only untracked files are the FEAT-002 tsconfig.build.json set + .agents task dir. Did NOT git add/commit/push (orchestrator publishes).

ALL ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA MET: build passes from clean; test passes with EXACT 2811; depcruise passes; all 3 images build from clean with runnable dist/main.js (worker also dist/index.js); no console built in any backend image.
